card.name: Range dashes and numbering markers
card.fires_on: Small marks inside numbers, ranges and numbered lists, such as a dash between two numbers, a Roman numeral, or 'No' before a number. The next thing expected is another number.

modes.label: Dash in a range
modes.description: A dash or colon between two numbers in a date, page or item range.

modes.label: Numeral or label before a number
modes.description: A Roman numeral, 'No', or ordinal ending that introduces or continues a numbered item.

modes.label: Digit within a number list
modes.description: The last digit of a year or number in a list of numbers.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining marks and labels inside numbers, like the dash in a range or a chapter numeral.
